title: The horrible truth about Apple's repeated engineering failures.
summary: Louis Rossmann, a Macbook repair shop owner, goes through a long list of Apple hardware engineering failures, from GPU defects to keyboards and repair practices.
why: Mostly cited by critics of Apple hardware quality, and as a rabbit hole for people curious about laptop repair.

quote.text: Louis Rossmann made a video highlighting a lot of the engineering problems with Apple laptops.
